description: Single-seed 25000-round training variant of the matching Task 2 V4/V3.6 TD(5) experiment with proportionally compressed exploration. Relative to the 50000-round V3.6 configuration, the training limit is reduced from 50000 to 25000 rounds and the epsilon schedule from task2_epsilon_35000_v1 to task2_epsilon_17500_v1. Epsilon therefore reaches 0.05 after 17500 rounds and remains there for the final 7500 rounds, preserving the 70/30 exploration-to-consolidation split. Reward hierarchy, Feature V4, target scale, five-step TD target, action space, visit-decay learning rate, gamma, checkpoint interval, seeds, and evaluation protocol are unchanged.
